name: datarelay-link
description: Secure access to authorized private hosts through DataRelay Link.

interface.shortDescription: Secure access to authorized private hosts through DataRelay Link.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to hosts authorized by your DataRelay Link Server. The Plugin talks to a DataRelay MCP relay; DRLink Server remains the final authorization source of truth on every tool call.
defaultPrompt: Use DataRelay Link to list tools available on my authorized host.
Use DataRelay Link only for actions my DRLink AI Access policy allows.
